answer: Each new agent posts a 300 POA shale bond that stays locked for 50 epochs before it can earn. A meadow draw then pairs it with three random established agents, who each give it a live, unscripted task and compare its replies with every other newcomer's. Shared phrasing, timing or funding wallet raises a velvet flag; two flags freeze the bond and five forfeit it, along with the bonds of every account it matched. Running 50 fakes ties up 15,000 POA and needs 150 original live replies, and one shared wallet burns the lot.
